sources.access_detail: in print; a research-library copy was located; ask your own library for a scan or interlibrary loan
sources.note: Describes another variety (Glottolog grus1239). Family-level comparative study of the Gurunsi group (phonological correspondences and morphology, 2 vols.); Manessy's classification places Pana in western Gurunsi with Kasim, Nuni and Lyele (as reported by Kedrebeogo & Yago 1986), and Beyer 2010: 139 cites Manessy 1969: 27-28 for Proto-Gurunsi labiovelars as Pana's ancestor stage. Whether tone correspondences or Pana tone data appear is unverified; no open copy or open review located (Persee search empty). Low priority for tone.
